title.narrative: To increase coverage of HIV and AIDS services in the general and sub-populations to meet 90, 90, 90 by 2020 - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), HIV, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To increase coverage of HIV and AIDS services in general population and sub-populations to ensure that by 2020, 90% of people living with HIV knows their status, 90% of all people diagnosed with HIV are enrolled, followed and receive timely and efficacious highly active antiretroviral therapy, and 90% of all people receiving the antiretroviral therapy will attain sustainable viral suppression.. The objectives of this program are: 90% of people living with HIV knows their status by 2020. 90% of all people diagnosed with HIV are enrolled, followed and receive timely and efficacious highly active antiretroviral therapy by 2020. 90% of all people receiving the antiretroviral therapy will attain sustainable viral suppression by 2020
